_comment: Expectations for the real supplier invoices a customer sent on 25 Sep 2026.
The PDFs themselves are gitignored - they carry supplier GSTINs, trade prices
and margins. Only structural facts live here: how many line items the invoice
has, how many printed copies the file contains, and which printed price column
the bill is actually charged on. No money figures are committed.
Drop the PDFs into this folder to run tests/test_real_invoices.py; without them

invoices.why: The original field complaint: 143 items displayed as 429, and the rate column showing PTR when the bill is charged on PTS.
Prints Rate, PTR and MRP side by side, and draws no table rules at all.
Prints M.R.P., P.T.S. and P.T.R.; billed on PTS less a line discount whose column is headed only '%'.

Bills on a column called NIR, heads its batch column 'Lot No.', and prints its grand total only in words - with no spaces between them. One line is a free replacement with no taxable value, so a single warning about it is correct.
